intro.text: A kingdom in western Roshar, ruled in theory by its oldest man and in practice by the Monavakah dynasty.
A kingdom in western Roshar whose capital, Panatham, holds an Oathgate. Its people are called Babath.

description.text: Babatharnam has peculiar trees that lie down completely when a highstorm approaches, trunk and all, as if on a hinge.
It is a gerontocracy: the older someone is, the more authority they have. In practice, the Monavakah dynasty executes or exiles anyone old enough to challenge it, and has kept power for fifty years.
Sigzil was jailed in Babatharnam three times, though he suspected its people would lock up any foreigner on the thinnest excuse, since his master had plenty of money.
Snails are part of the diet in Babatharnam.
The women of Babatharnam have an intricate web of veins lying just beneath the skin, which many foreigners find unsettling.
Babatharnam touches the Purelake, Yulay, Marabethia and Rira. Besides its capital, Panatham, its towns include Sween; two rivers cross the country, and a third marks the border with Yulay.

told.title: Out of Sela Tales
told.text: In the Heraldic Epochs, Babatharnam's lands belonged to the Silver Kingdom of Sela Tales. Some time after Aharietiam, Sela Tales splintered into many small states, and Babatharnam grew out of them.

told.title: The Monavakah dynasty
told.text: Around 1120 the Monavakah dynasty came to power, though custom there gives the most authority to the oldest. It held on by killing or exiling anyone old enough to challenge it, and its assassinations left the country deeply unsettled.

told.title: No help for Dalinar
told.text: Early in the True Desolation, Babatharnam's Most Ancient refused to work with Dalinar Kholin.
